summary: localize the mobile robot; estimate current map pose, x y yaw, AMCL pose, localization confidence, covariance
description: Reports the robot's estimated pose in the map frame. Output may include x, y, yaw, covariance, and localization confidence, for example 'pose x=1.23 y=-0.40 yaw=92deg confidence=0.86'. Report the current pose clearly and warn if confidence is low. Does not accept parameters.
